reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: Cookie value from 'TRUSTED_PREF' cookie reaches response writer after HTML encoding. Resolved sink value: Encode.forHtml(cookie_value_from_TRUSTED_PREF). Encoding mitigates reflection but does not make the source inherently safe.
